title: Taiwan Excellence Showcasing Green Living at ARCHIDEX 2023 | Daily Express Malaysia - Sabah's Leading News Portal
text:
Taiwan Excellence Showcasing Green Living at ARCHIDEX 2023 | Daily Express Malaysia - Sabah's Leading News Portal
(From Left to Right): Ts. Dr. Tan Kok Hong, Head of Department of Architecture & Sustainable Design, University Tunku Abdul Rahman, Associate Professor Ar. Dr Lim Yaik Wah, Director of Architecture, Faculty of Built Environment and Surveying, Universiti Teknologi Malaysia, Mr. James Hsu, General Director of Innolux Corporation, Ms. Eva Peng, Director of Taiwan Trade Center, Kuala Lumpur, Mr. James Chang, Director of Economic Division, Taipei Economic and Cultural Office in Malaysia, Dato’ Vincent Lim, President of C.I.S Network Sdn Bhd. Some of the featured products include Innolux’s "Smart Dimming LC Window," which automatically adjusts lighting to significantly reduce building energy consumption; San Jeou Building Material’s newly developed "Auto Flood Barrier Shutter", which combines anti-theft and waterproof functions; and BenQ Materials' "PDLC Smart Optical Film," which blocks heat and ultraviolet light to combat urban heat waves. Advertisement In the field of interior design and smart homes, Taiwan Excellence invited three companies that previously received the ARCHIDEX Star Awards to showcase their latest products: YZTEK's "e+Autoff" stove safety device, JLA's "Touch-Free Easy Installation Sensor Flush Kit", and Medusa's "i-WaterProof" liquid type additives. Additionally, JUSTIME's "Kitchen Faucet with Pull Out Sprayer", AWA’s "Robin RO Kitchen Mixer", ALASKA’s "M8 Mini Anti-Bacterial Circulator," and FECA’s "Laundry Net Set with Lid" have all received favorable attention and inquiries from visitors. (From Left to Right): Ts. Dr. Tan Kok Hong, Head of Department of Architecture & Sustainable Design, University Tunku Abdul Rahman, Associate Professor Ar. Dr Lim Yaik Wah, Director of Architecture, Faculty of Built Environment and Surveying, Universiti Teknologi Malaysia, Dato’ Vincent Lim, President of C.I.S Network Sdn Bhd, Mr. James Chang, Director of Economic Division, Taipei Economic and Cultural Office in Malaysia, Mr. Aldirich Lai, Business Development Manager of BenQ Materials Corp, Ms. Eva Peng, Director of Taiwan Trade Center, Kuala Lumpur Advertisement James Chang, Director of the Economic Division at the Taipei Economic and Cultural Office in Malaysia, stated that Malaysia is a key focus of Taiwan's New Southbound Policy, Taiwan holds significant importance as a trading and investment partner for Malaysia. This year, the Taiwan Excellence Pavilion at ARCHIDEX is built around the concept of "Connect. Cultivate. Consolidate," introducing Taiwan's green living approach to Malaysian audiences throughout the four-day exhibition. It aims to establish connections between the interior design and architectural business networks of Taiwan and Malaysia, nurturing emerging stars in the industry, while also showcasing creative ideas. Eva Peng, Director of the Taiwan Trade Center Kuala Lumpur, expressed that for the first time, Taiwan Excellence collaborated with the Architecture Department of Universiti Teknologi Malaysia (UTM) and the Architecture and Sustainable Design Department of Universiti Tunku Abdul Rahman (UTAR) to host the "Sustainable Innovation Challenge”. Participants utilized Taiwan Excellence products to exercise innovative thinking and address local sustainability issues. The highly anticipated finals are scheduled for July 28th, with the involvement of the Malaysian Institute of Architects (PAM), the Malaysia Green Building Council (MGBC), and the Building Materials Distributors Association of Malaysia (BMDAM) participating in evaluating and selecting the most forward-thinking design concepts. This event aims to foster networking opportunities within the Taiwan-Malaysia architectural and interior design industry. The ARCHIDEX is the most influential and extensive comprehensive building materials exhibition in Southeast Asia, providing a crucial platform for Taiwan's building material industry to expand its reputation and cooperation opportunities in the Southeast Asian market. This year's Taiwan Excellence Pavilion is showcasing at booth 2L178 in the Kuala Lumpur Convention Centre from July 26th to July 29th, demonstrating the abundant innovative energy that Taiwan Excellence brings to life.
